concepts.title: Concept and Verification of Linear Equation Solutions
concepts.definition: An algebraic statement of equality where a single variable appears with an exponent of at most one, whose solution is the specific numerical value making both sides equal.
concepts.key_idea: Substituting the correct value into an equation balances the values of both expressions.
question_patterns: check if the given value is a solution of the equation
verify whether the value satisfies the linear equation
test if the equation is satisfied by the given variable value
is the given number a root of the equation

solution_steps.explain: Substitute the candidate value for the variable in the LHS expression.

concepts.title: Solving Linear Equations with Variables on Both Sides
concepts.definition: Technique of solving equations of the form ax + b = cx + d by transposing all variable terms to one side and all constant terms to the other.
concepts.key_idea: Transposing a term across the equals sign inverts its operational sign.
question_patterns: solve 7x + 2 = 5x + 8 with the variable on both sides
solve the equation with variables on both sides
find the value of the unknown variable in the given equation
calculate the solution for the linear equation
what is the value of the variable satisfying the equation
Solve 5x + 3 = 3x + 11.
Find x when 7m - 4 = 3m + 12.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the RHS variable coefficient from the LHS variable coefficient.
Subtract the LHS constant from the RHS constant.
Divide the combined constant by the combined coefficient.

concepts.title: Solving Linear Equations by Clearing Denominators
concepts.definition: Method of simplifying rational linear equations by multiplying every term by the least common multiple of all denominators present.
concepts.key_idea: Multiplying the entire equation by the common denominator removes all fractional terms.
question_patterns: solve the linear equation involving fractions
reduce the fractional equation to simpler form and solve
find the solution of the equation with fractional coefficients
simplify and calculate the value of the variable
Clear denominators and solve t/3 - 1/4 = 1/2.

solution_steps.explain: Compute net coefficient after combining fractions on both sides.
Compute net constant after transposing constant fractions.
Divide net constant by net coefficient to obtain the root.

concepts.title: Solving Linear Equations Involving Parentheses
concepts.definition: Process of removing brackets using the distributive property, gathering like terms together, and solving the resulting standard linear equation.
concepts.key_idea: Distribute multiplying factors across parentheses before transposing terms.
question_patterns: simplify and solve the linear equation with brackets
expand parentheses and find the value of the variable
solve the equation by opening brackets
determine the variable value after removing grouping symbols
Solve 3(x - 2) = 12.
Open the brackets and solve 2(4 - y) = 10.

solution_steps.explain: Expand all brackets and combine variable terms across both sides.
Expand all brackets and combine constant terms across both sides.
Divide the net constant by the net coefficient.
